title: SignalStack Frontend ↔ API Contract Snapshot
description: Schema for contract snapshot files that define the expected shape of API responses consumed by the frontend. Each file represents one API endpoint contract.

endpoint.description: API path template (e.g., /api/v1/portfolio/holdings). Path parameters use {param} syntax.

auth.description: Whether authentication is required for this endpoint

description.description: Human-readable description of what this endpoint does

requestFields.description: Expected fields in the request body (for POST/PUT/PATCH only)

type.description: JSON type: string, number, boolean, object, array, string[]

responseFields.description: Expected fields in the response body

type.description: JSON type: string, number, boolean, object, array, string[], number[], or null

required.description: Whether this field is always present

statusCodes.description: HTTP status codes this endpoint can return
